# qestack

> qestack: QA and test automation skills, agents and quality gates for AI coding agents. One Claude Code plugin with a QA library (39 Quality Engineering skills and 8 reviewer personas for any stack, no engine needed) and a gated workflow with an engine that proves AI-written tests catch bugs (spec-first test design, red-before-green, test locks, hidden faults, mutation score, independent judge).

Install in Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add quark-sri/qestack`, then `/plugin install qestack@qestack`. Other agents that read SKILL.md: `scripts/install-skills.sh <skills-folder>`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/README.md): what qestack does, install, gates and limits
- [Why qestack](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/docs/why-qestack.md): the problem with AI-written tests and the metrics
- [Architecture](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): engine, plugin, hook and project folder
- [Other agents](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/docs/other-agents.md): use the skills with Codex, Cursor and Copilot

## QA library skills (no engine needed)

- [accessibility-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/accessibility-testing/SKILL.md): Test web and app accessibility against the accessibility guidelines (WCAG level AA)
- [api-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/api-testing/SKILL.md): Write or improve tests for HTTP APIs (REST, GraphQL, RPC over HTTP)
- [bug-hunter](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/bug-hunter/SKILL.md): Hunt for real bugs in code, a change, a module or a feature
- [bug-report](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/bug-report/SKILL.md): Write a clear, reproducible defect report from a failing test, a log, a stack trace, a user complaint or a review finding
- [change-impact](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/change-impact/SKILL.md): Analyze the testing impact of a code change (a diff, branch, commit range or pull request)
- [ci-cd-integration](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/ci-cd-integration/SKILL.md): Design or fix how tests run in the delivery pipeline
- [contract-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/contract-testing/SKILL.md): Set up and write contract tests between consumers and providers of APIs and events
- [database-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/database-testing/SKILL.md): Test persistence and data integrity against a real database engine
- [edge-case-hunter](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/edge-case-hunter/SKILL.md): Hunt the edge, boundary and negative cases of a feature, function, endpoint, form or data flow, with a catalog for numbers, text, dates and time, money, collections, identifiers, files, state, concurrency, users and security, integrations and configuration
- [exploratory-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/exploratory-testing/SKILL.md): Plan, run and report session-based exploratory testing
- [flaky-test-detective](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/flaky-test-detective/SKILL.md): Find the root cause of a flaky test, a test that passes and fails with no code change
- [localization-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/localization-testing/SKILL.md): Test internationalization (i18n) and localization (l10n)
- [messaging-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/messaging-testing/SKILL.md): Test event-driven and asynchronous systems with a real broker
- [mutation-probe](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/mutation-probe/SKILL.md): Measure test strength with mutation testing
- [performance-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/performance-testing/SKILL.md): Plan, write, run and analyze performance tests
- [production-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/production-testing/SKILL.md): Test and verify quality in production, after release
- [qa-navigator](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qa-navigator/SKILL.md): Route a QA request to the right qestack skill and give the next steps, when the request does not clearly match one skill
- [qa-project-context](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qa-project-context/SKILL.md): Create or update .agents/qa-project-context.md, the one file that records the product, tech stack, test stack, test commands, CI, environments, quality goals, risk areas and conventions of a project
- [quality-postmortem](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/quality-postmortem/SKILL.md): Run a blameless quality postmortem for an escaped defect or incident
- [release-readiness](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/release-readiness/SKILL.md): Decide go or no-go for a release with evidence
- [requirement-gaps](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/requirement-gaps/SKILL.md): Find gaps in requirements before tests or code exist
- [resilience-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/resilience-testing/SKILL.md): Test how a system behaves when a dependency fails
- [risk-based-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/risk-based-testing/SKILL.md): Build a risk matrix for a product, release, feature or change
- [roast-my-code](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/roast-my-code/SKILL.md): A direct, honest code review with a quality engineering focus
- [security-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/security-testing/SKILL.md): Plan and write security tests for an application or API
- [service-virtualization](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/service-virtualization/SKILL.md): Simulate external and third-party services in tests with stubs, fakes and simulated servers
- [spec-drift](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/spec-drift/SKILL.md): Detect drift between what is specified, documented, built and tested
- [test-case-designer](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-case-designer/SKILL.md): Design test cases from requirements with formal techniques
- [test-coverage-map](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-coverage-map/SKILL.md): Map what is tested and what is not, by requirement, feature, user journey, code area and test level, not only by line coverage
- [test-data-management](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-data-management/SKILL.md): Design and build test data
- [test-environments](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-environments/SKILL.md): Set up reliable, reproducible test environments
- [test-planning](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-planning/SKILL.md): Write a test plan for one sprint, release, epic or feature
- [test-review-panel](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-review-panel/SKILL.md): Review tests or a change with a panel of independent reviewer personas, then merge their findings into one ranked list with no duplicates
- [test-runner](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-runner/SKILL.md): Find out how a project runs its tests, run the right subset (all, a module, a file, one test, a tag, or the tests related to a change), collect the results, and triage every failure as product bug, test defect, environment problem or flaky test, with evidence
- [test-strategy](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-strategy/SKILL.md): Write a test strategy for a product, a system or a team
- [testability-review](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/testability-review/SKILL.md): Score and improve how testable a feature, module or design is before tests are written
- [testcase-reviewer](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/testcase-reviewer/SKILL.md): Review automated tests or manual test cases like a senior test architect
- [ui-automation](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/ui-automation/SKILL.md): Write, fix or structure browser and UI end-to-end tests for the few critical user journeys
- [unit-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/unit-testing/SKILL.md): Write, fix or improve unit tests for business rules, calculations, validation, mapping and state logic

## Gated workflow skills (need the qestack engine)

- [qe-audit](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-audit/SKILL.md): qestack read-only quality report for an existing test suite or module, also without feature tags
- [qe-calibrate](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-calibrate/SKILL.md): Measures how far the qestack judge agrees with human reviewers (agreement and Cohen's kappa) on a human audit sample, and proposes rubric improvements for the disagreements
- [qe-grill-spec](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-grill-spec/SKILL.md): Finds requirements without IDs, vague rules, missing examples, missing error behavior and untestable statements, and asks the user one question at a time
- [qe-harden](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-harden/SKILL.md): Seeds hidden faults, runs the gates, gets an independent judge review, scores the result and improves the tests
- [qe-judge](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-judge/SKILL.md): qestack independent review of one feature's tagged tests with the qe-test-judge agent and the qestack rubric
- [qe-plan](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-plan/SKILL.md): Writes a spec-first test plan (test-plan.md) for one feature with the qe-test-designer agent, then gets an independent plan review from the qe-test-judge agent
- [qe-prove](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-prove/SKILL.md): Proves that the new feature tests fail before the implementation exists, then locks them so that later work cannot weaken them
- [qe-setup](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-setup/SKILL.md): Set up qestack AI test quality in a repository
- [qe-write](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-write/SKILL.md): Writes the feature tests from test-plan.md with the qe-test-writer agent, without the implementation, then passes the lint and trace gates
- [qestack](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qestack/SKILL.md): Entry point for qestack AI test quality

## Review personas (read-only agents)

- [ai-behavior-auditor](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/ai-behavior-auditor.md): Finds the shortcuts that AI coding agents take to make work look done
- [determinism-flakiness-engineer](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/determinism-flakiness-engineer.md): Finds the causes of non-deterministic tests
- [domain-oracle-reviewer](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/domain-oracle-reviewer.md): Checks each expected result in the tests against the requirements, the acceptance criteria and the domain rules
- [hallucination-checker](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/hallucination-checker.md): Checks that each API, method, class, fixture, helper, configuration property, command-line flag, file path, endpoint and library version that the code or the tests use really exists in this project, its dependencies or its documentation
- [maintainability-craftsperson](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/maintainability-craftsperson.md): Reviews single tests for clarity and ease of change
- [saboteur](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/saboteur.md): Designs small, realistic faults in the production code, predicts which faults the tests would not catch, and returns a fault plan with the exact change for each fault
- [suite-cost-speed-reviewer](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/suite-cost-speed-reviewer.md): Reviews how long the test suite takes and what it costs
- [test-automation-architect](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/test-automation-architect.md): Reviews the structure of a test suite

## Workflow agents (gated workflow)

- [qe-fault-seeder](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/qe-fault-seeder.md): Creates realistic, requirement-level faults as patches (never left in the code) to measure whether the feature tests detect real defects
- [qe-test-designer](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/qe-test-designer.md): Writes a spec-first test plan (test-plan.md) for one feature
- [qe-test-judge](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/qe-test-judge.md): Skeptical reviewer of test plans, tests and fault catalogs
- [qe-test-writer](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/qe-test-writer.md): Writes or improves automated tests from test-plan.md for one feature, without reading the feature implementation ("blind")
